decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording Heyzine, white-label branding, client account ownership, client upload responsibility, and removal of obsolete platform-selection attributes.
The PDF delivery handoff does not change the whitespace-balancing requirement; the separate no-extra-text clause is already represented by its same-message MODIFY.
Sending the final PDF to the client for Heyzine upload does not alter the requirement that advertisements render clearly.
The delivery handoff and Heyzine upload responsibility do not change the selected article typeface or weight treatment.
The client-upload handoff does not change the table-of-contents completion condition or page-number accuracy requirement.
The source assigns PDF upload responsibility to the client but does not change the launch deadline or required live state.
The final-PDF delivery handoff does not modify the requirement to enhance low-quality publication images.
The Heyzine upload handoff has no effect on author names, photos, sizing, shape, coverage, or photo source.
The hosting handoff does not alter the magazine's visual style, WBEdition branding reference, or color-use constraints.
